englishSummary.headline: Clarified sponsor permissions for agent resources
englishSummary.summary: Sponsors can disable agent identities, modify sponsors, and soft-delete resources, but cannot enable or restore agent blueprints or identities.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Resource owners or administrators must recover resources if a sponsor disables or deletes one by mistake.
